
`/tasks` and `/projects/$projectId/tasks` are the SPA's task tables, replacing the templ routes `GET /work`, `GET /projects/{id}/work`, `GET /projects/{id}/tasks/new` and `POST /projects/{id}/tasks`, which are deleted with their `routeGuards` entries in the same change (WL-REQ-1305). Both read `GET /api/v1/tasks` (`/tasks` without a project; the project page with `project=<id>`), asking for the open states (draft, ready, in progress, in review) unless the State filter names others, which are then what it asks for and show one `TaskList` with columns title (a link to the task's canonical URL, WL-RULE-1306), project (on `/tasks` only, a select over `GET /api/v1/projects` with `unknownLabel: "Deleted project"` once projects have loaded), assignee (a person picker over `GET /api/v1/crew`), due (a date picker), state (a select over the task states; the picker sends `EditTaskInput.state` and shows the server's refusal when a state is not settable), priority and row actions (delete through `DELETE /api/v1/tasks/{id}`). Sort, filters and search live in the URL. Edits are optimistic through `src/api/list-mutations.ts`: an edit shows at once, is undone when the server refuses, and the list refetches after the last overlapping write; a create waits for the server. Creating a task (title, project on `/tasks`, priority, kind `feature`) uses `POST /api/v1/tasks`.

The `PROJECTS` list resource declares `alsoInvalidate: [tasks, documents]`, so if a project delete is added to the SPA, the task and document lists refetch after it.
